summary: John's 3rd cousin 7x removed (Job → Job 2d → Epenetus → Deborah → Joshua B.), also 4C6R and 4C7R; last master of the Hauppauge estate.
bio: Buried in Hauppauge Rural Cemetery (former Methodist churchyard, 473 Townline Road). His daughter Ellen left in 1861 on marrying Dr. Jarvis R. Mowbray; the farm was sold in 1868. HABS NY-5414 'Joshua Brewster Smith House' photographs at the Library of Congress.
